page.overview:
Who is Fahrak?

Fahrak was a minor character who appeared in Mortal Kombat: Conquest series in the episode entitled “Festival Of Death”. He was portrayed by Timothy McLaughlin.

Fahrak was a villager who wanted to find his brother, who was kidnapped by the Festival of Death. After he and a couple of villagers found the Festival's stagecoach they stopped it and ordered them to give back him his brother. Two Festival members then came out from the coach and killed Fahrak and his companions.
